version.changelog: Hardcode gateway URL (remove env var override flagged as redirect risk). Fix homepage domain to 19pine.ai to match API host.

llm.summary: The skill's files and instructions match its stated purpose (making phone calls and returning transcripts), but there are notable concerns: it asks you to supply potentially sensitive context for calls, it sends call data to remote Pine servers, and the code targets a staging gateway hostname (agent3-api-gateway-staging.19pine.ai) which is unexpected for a published skill.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (make phone calls, negotiate, transcript) match the included scripts: auth-request/verify, call, and call-status that POST to 19pine.ai endpoints and store a local credentials file. Required binary (node) is proportional.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to ask the user for their Pine AI email and verification code (expected), to collect full 'callee_context' (which may include account numbers/payment info) and to send all call data to Pine's servers for processing. Requiring users to provide third-party authentication/payment details is privacy-sensitive and the guidance to gather 'every piece of information the callee might need' can encourage users to disclose unnecessary secrets. The scripts themselves only read/write the local credentials file and stdin/stdout.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec / no downloads. The skill is instruction + small node scripts included in the bundle; nothing is fetched or extracted at install-time. Execution risk is limited to running the shipped scripts with node.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or external credentials beyond a Pine access token obtained via the email verification flow. Storing credentials at ~/.pine-voice/credentials.json is reasonable, but users should note call audio/transcripts are processed remotely. The code points to a 'staging' gateway hostname (agent3-api-gateway-staging.19pine.ai) rather than an obvious production API host — this mismatch is unexpected and should be verified with the publisher.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true, does not modify other skills, and only writes a credential file under the user's home directory with restrictive permissions (0600). Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default); combine that with the skill's ability to place long calls and send data offbox when deciding trust.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says, but proceed with caution. Before installing or using it: 1) Verify the vendor/site (https://19pine.ai) and confirm why the scripts call a 'staging' gateway hostname — ask the publisher or check their docs. 2) Do not provide passwords or full payment-card numbers unless you explicitly trust the vendor and understand their data retention/processing. Prefer to provide only minimal identifiers or temporary tokens and avoid sharing bank/CVV/passwords. 3) Understand that call audio and transcripts are sent to Pine's servers; check their privacy policy and retention rules. 4) After use, inspect or delete ~/.pine-voice/credentials.json if you no longer need the service. 5) If you need stronger assurance, contact the vendor for a production API endpoint and more transparency about where audio/transcripts are stored and how long they are kept.
